sources.title: PROFILE synthetic source
sources.extraction_text: Assumed losses-occurring occurrence XOL without reinstatements, USD, property, SYNTHETIC-INTERNAL, TREATY-CEDAR-26. Effective 2026-01-01 through 2027-12-31. Limits and layer premium at 100%; event amounts ultimate including LAE and already net of scheduled inuring cover.

sources.title: TERMS synthetic source
sources.extraction_text: Cedent Synthetic Cedent 9; term [2026-07-01,2027-07-01). Attachment 100; occurrence limit 200; annual aggregate limit 300; signed share .25; 100% layer premium 240; brokerage .10; commission .05; fixed signed expense 5; reinstatements 0. Covered peril wind; covered territory East.

sources.title: SCENARIOS synthetic source
sources.extraction_text: Exhaustive reviewed scenarios: quiet p=.4 with no events; active p=.6 with wind East events A on 2026-10-01 loss350, B on 2027-02-01 loss300, C on 2027-07-01 loss1000; earthquake East D on 2027-03-01 loss1000. All amounts ultimate including LAE net of scheduled inuring cover; externally supplied event aggregation.
